evidence_boundaries: The pair-plasma paper is an analytic quantum-fluid and KdV parameter study, not an experiment or a kinetic validation.
The 2-keV neutron source is a GEANT4 design study; the local full text is the corresponding arXiv author preprint, not the APS version of record.
The plasma-waveguide and magnetized-shock studies report 2.5D and one-dimensional PIC evidence respectively, without three-dimensional or experimental closure.
The SympNet study is restricted to a McMillan-type toy map and has no equal-accuracy production benchmark.
The PHITS record received a publication-metadata upgrade only; no transport case was rerun locally.
No KdV coefficient calculation, GEANT4, MCNP, SOM, SympNet, Entity or PHITS computation was performed locally.
